status: Isolated startup and save-directory repair confirmed; localized ending subsequently rendered through return to menu

scope.installation_scope: Private isolated game only; formal game unchanged

observations.context: Independent 32-bit program launched by command tool
Same independent program launched by node_repl child_process
Isolated game launched from Explorer, diagnostic DLL
observations.purpose: First obtain the system error; then inspect the registry root and failing path prefix

observations.context: Independent read-only context checker launched from Explorer

finding: The isolated registry identity created in the command environment was not visible to Explorer-launched processes. The same failure without the game rules out a game-only cause. The mechanism producing the context difference has not been identified.

completed_attempt.method: Enumerate and copy registry values and child keys without copying security descriptors
completed_attempt.destination_guard: Refuse a nonempty target; refuse any already-existing destination child
completed_attempt.nonempty_guard_validation: Independent execution against the command environment's existing 10-child vp1 key stopped before any copy or value write

runtime_chain.initial_followup: Outer guard passed after the registry repair; nested choice-glyph guard still expected the original executable identity.
runtime_chain.repair: Rebind the nested private DLL's expected host hash and the outer DLL's expected private-DLL hash to the isolated files; retain guard logic.
runtime_chain.observed: PID 168212 reached Chinese CAUTION, title and load UI without either guard error. It reported missing system data and showed empty normal/quick-load lists.

save_directory_diagnosis.offline_decode: All 38 copied normal saves decode into two blocks with valid full and partial group checksums and zero trailing bytes.
save_directory_diagnosis.identity_observation: Metadata contains age\muvluv_pm_v11 and muvluv_pm_v11. No identity rejection was established; these fields were not edited.

native_code.cache: 0x452f1b returns without rescanning when 0x6d13bc >= 1; observed value remained 2 after returning to title and reopening Load.
native_code.metadata_reader: 0x5c5b10 reads the two encrypted blocks; 0x5c5740 reads the metadata strings.

save_directory_diagnosis.correction: Copy the original Rebirth normal saves 4 and 27 unchanged into the isolated app-data parent directory; preserve the previous Vmreg copies.
save_directory_diagnosis.post_correction_restart_result: PID 168616 displays slots 4 and 27 as Resurrection after one normal restart. Slot 4 was loaded successfully into the matching indoor character scene without changing its v11 metadata identity. The initial loaded screenshots had no visible text box; no dialogue text was inferred from them.

references.scope: RegCopyTreeW also copies security descriptors; this alone does not prove why the observed call returned error 5
Independent implementation of registry value and child enumeration; not evidence of this Windows process's behavior

limitations: Isolated host identity bindings are validation setup, not a player deliverable.
Ending playback and bounded audio/video measurement are recorded separately; direct human listening is not established.
Formal game and v11 registry were not modified.
